cases.behavior: Public doctor accepts valid ZCode user Hooks and repairs disabled or duplicate entries.
cases.reproduction: Reproduced on npm 0.5.2 and pre-fix 00a47ebc in isolated projects; see docs/architecture/issue-540-542-and-dashboard-settings.zh.md.
cases.expected: A valid Hook passes before and after repair; invalid entries warn and can be repaired.
cases.forbidden: Treating every global Hook as residue or accepting disabled and duplicate entries.
cases.rootCause: Doctor ignored the supported global Hook policy used by installation.

tests.namePattern: keeps a valid ZCode global Hook healthy through public doctor repair and repairs disabled or duplicate Hooks

cases.behavior: Project update preserves the effective ZCode user Hook without installing ignored project Hooks.
cases.reproduction: Reproduced on npm 0.5.2 and pre-fix 00a47ebc in isolated projects; see docs/architecture/issue-540-542-and-dashboard-settings.zh.md.
cases.expected: Leave user configuration unchanged and explain the user-scoped install command.
cases.forbidden: Deleting the user Hook or reporting an ignored project Hook as installed.
cases.rootCause: Project reconciliation installed locally and removed the global Hook.
